abstract: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) remains a major therapeutic challenge, with limited improvement in outcomes and substantial heterogeneity in treatment response. Systemic chemotherapy remains a cornerstone of treatment across disease stages, yet treatment selection, particularly in metastatic PDAC (mPDAC), is still driven predominantly by clinical characteristics, performance status, prior therapy, and a limited number of molecular biomarkers. The emergence of biomarker-directed therapies, including strategies targeting oncogenic KRAS alterations, demonstrates the potential of molecularly informed treatment selection but also highlights the need to identify which therapy is most likely to benefit an individual patient at a specific clinical decision point. Recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI), multi-omics profiling, digital pathology, and prospective therapeutic trials provide an opportunity to develop comprehensive precision-treatment strategies. Existing AI approaches, including PASS-01/MULTIPL, PDACai, and CHAI, provide important foundations but remain constrained by limitations in prognostic versus predictive modeling, reliance on predominantly static or correlational representations, limited mechanistic interpretability, and incomplete integration of treatment effects and evolving tumor biology. In this narrative review, we propose a conceptual framework for individualized treatment selection in mPDAC that integrates multiscale biological and clinical data, mechanistic graph-based pathway representations, multimodal transformer models, and causal estimation of individualized treatment effects. This framework shifts AI-enabled precision oncology from static biomarker prediction toward mechanistically informed, uncertainty-aware, causally grounded treatment selection, with the potential to adapt as tumor biology, therapeutic options, and clinical evidence evolve. Although initially focused on mPDAC, the framework provides a generalizable architecture for individualized treatment selection across other biologically heterogeneous cancers.
key_points_ko: 췌관선암은 치료 반응의 이질성과 제한된 치료 성적으로 인해 여전히 큰 임상적 도전 과제입니다.
기존의 인공지능(AI) 접근법들은 예후 예측 모델링, 정적 표현, 제한된 기계론적 해석력 등의 한계가 있습니다.
이번에 제안된 프레임워크는 다중 스케일 생물학적 및 임상적 데이터, 멀티모달 트랜스포머 모델 등을 통합하여 개별화된 치료 효과를 인과적으로 추정합니다.
summary_ko: 이 논문은 췌관선암(PDAC) 환자의 치료 선택을 개선하기 위한 개념적 프레임워크를 제안하는 문헌 고찰 논문입니다. 전이성 췌관선암(mPDAC) 환자들을 대상으로 생물학적 데이터, 인공지능(AI), 다중 오믹스 프로파일링 등을 통합하여 개별화된 치료 전략을 수립하는 방안을 다루었습니다. 기존 AI 모델의 한계를 극복하고 기계론적이고 인과관계에 기반한 치료 선택을 가능하게 하는 구조를 제시했습니다.
title: Treatment Selection in Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma: A Conceptual Framework for Precision Therapy
title_ko: 췌관선암 치료 선택: 정밀 치료를 위한 개념적 프레임워크
